summary: CKGSB's marketing team is in a critical push to boost search visibility for Asia Star and Intelligent China while finalizing the knowledge website redesign, but an Outlook lockout and several pending approvals are demanding immediate attention.
summaryDetail: The top priority is the search visibility strategy for Asia Star and Intelligent China, with Joseph drafting a target-areas document and the team analyzing participant profiles and CRM leads to inform conversion tracking. The knowledge website redesign is nearing completion: the team has approved the two-menu structure and video dispersion, and Joseph must share his HTML design for a working session to finalize feedback. Urgent this week: resolve the Outlook account lockout by contacting JSB for backend unlock and updating saved passwords, and kick off promotion for the 2026 Women in Leadership Forum now that speakers are confirmed. Upcoming: finalize the Western MBA faculty training press release, get Professor Li's greenlight on the translated Business Sentiment Index report, and review Joseph's YouTube edit plan for all 233 videos.

decisions.text: Stale saved passwords on non-updated devices caused repeated failed logins and account lockout.
Remove the standalone videos section and disperse videos by topic across the site
Keep the two-menu structure (Knowledge and School) with School menu top right
Bring BCI (and BSI) index banners into the knowledge section, not the stock-market ticker
Use card designs to visually distinguish content types (professor, article, etc.)
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China programs for promotion, with Berkeley as a potential third priority.
Wait until the homepage is launched before sending the flow design PPT/email to Zongchao, and include both website URLs
